title_sq: SHITET AMBJENT KOMERCIAL NE RRUGE KRYESORE
description_sq:
Shitet Ambjent Komerciale me siperfaqe 70m², kati 0, ne rruge kryesore.
Dyqani eshte i sapo restauruar dhe invetuar totalisht.
Organizohet ne 2 ambjente dhe 2 tualete.
Ka fasade te madhe nga rruga, fasade ne cdo kend dhe mundesi ndarje ne 2 dyqane.
Dhenia me qera e dyqanit varion nga 1500-1800€.
Mundesi e mire investimi.
Ndodhet ne rr.Asim Vokshi perball shkolles Hurry Fultz, prane zogut te zi.
title_en: COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR SALE ON THE MAIN STREET
description_en: Commercial space for sale with an area of ​​70m², floor 0, on the main street. The store has just been restored and completely invested. It is organized in 2 rooms and 2 toilets. It has a large facade from the street, facades in every corner and the possibility of dividing into 2 shops. The rent of the shop varies from 1500-1800€. Good investment opportunity. It is located on Asim Vokshi St. in front of Hurry Fultz School, near the black bird.
